content: Yise, o'no ka tunayasamakwuse, mu tunaka'oedyukudu nanano'o sumu, ka o'no tabewa-wi ka Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhina.
Gi obeda yise unu hukwadu-kwa'ne nanakabetu, yise pa'anakwana ka nobe-kwi kangabetu.
Hee goso-ga-kwa'ne'yoo no'oko umu-ma aatahoobetu.
Oosoo Te Naa Besa Pooha mu tzapoonnekuna ka Te Naa umu sootuha'e. Oosoo Te Naa Besa Pooha no'oko umu oe manepunnedu, sootuhihoo umu yise nanakumma'amakoosoo yadooape-ma apegeakooha.
Ewa'yoo nananesootuhidu umu tzage'e nonobe-ga'yoo. Nanakumma'akoosoo

teepu-koobatoo nadooamudoopu, pana meno'o yow Jerusalem-wi. Ka mu nakase, umu punno'o sumuhoo. Gi umu oo nakasopedakwatoo yise nanatubengamo'o, “Tamme nanakumma'akoosoo teepu-koobatu kemmana pana umuoo nanana no'yoona Galilee-witu. Ha'oo yise umu no'oko tamme yadooa-ma apegeagonno? Tamme nanasusu'mu'yoona mu naka ka tamme yadooa-ma mu apegeagonno ka no'oko ka Te Naa besa tumaduguna mu wahagonno.”
Meeoo yise nananetamma, “How namani?”
Umu-matu meeoo unakwe, “Umu tookwa baako'e.”
Mu tuukwewabe yosuhoose, soo Peter paba yadooa ka mu Jew numu meeoo netamma, “E pupua'amu, besa e nakapunne.
‘Baako'e’ mee umu ne netamma. Gi numme. Tamme Jew numu gi atsa tutza'emukwa baa hebedu awamooasoo, ka gisoo tukana. Meno'o togesoo sumu kadoo'oopu-kwi (9) taba-gatu.
Yowsoo Te Naa yadooawabe o'nosoo tamme oo tuukwepu. Te Naa yadooawabe Joel mee naneadu, mee tubotugupu,

content.text: Te Naa meeoo te netamma, ‘Nu gisoo ka teepu atasoo yugwena, nuga pooha-matu no'oko nana'atakoosoo numu nanakumma'akoosoo poohabe-matu-ma sootuhidooa. Mu doodooamu tooe saa'a a unnena wahadooa. Tootooebetse'e saa'a pooha tuusoobedyadooa. Mu wakwa'etse saa'a punno'o pooha nosedooa.
Mu momoko'ne, mu nanana e naka'oedyukudu saa'a nu E Besa Pooha-matu-ma sootuhidooa. Umu yise e unnepu wahamodooa.
Tooe hownnekoo tooe saa'a nu mu tsapoonnekudooa ka hemma oo manekwuse, ka teepu-koobatoo tooetoo mu pa'anakwatoo: puupe, goso, kweedaba.
Ka o'no tabeba-wi ka teepu atasoo oo yugwekwuse mu notu tonumapunnekwu. Soo muha unu atsakwedyana puupe-kwa'ne tabuadooa.
Pana no'oko nuka nanetzakwiyidu nu magwetzoidooa.’

content: E pupua'amu, soo Jesus Te Pabe'e. Soo Te Naa meeoo unakwe, ‘Oosoo Mu Pabe'e,’ mee'e. Mu oo sopedakwatoo ka besa mumme oo tumadugukupu ka Te Naa pooha-ma.
Pana mu yise ka oo-ma tu natzakaduse, mu ka gi tunaka'oedyukudu wakwawa'a ooka batsa tuungu, ‘Pa'a o taposa,’ mee mu netamma. ‘Mu tunetamma-kwa'nesoo mu mani,’ mee soo Te Naa.
Oo tunetamma-kwa'ne, gi tubetse ya'e saa'a petudooasoo.
Soo Te Naa yadooawabe David mee naneadu ookow waha ka Te Pabe'e-witu te tuukwepuna.

content.text: ‘Nu oo sopedakwatoo soo Te Naa ooosapa nu-notu. Nu gi hownnekoo nammayamoa-wa'ne'yoo ka ooosapa Te Naa nuka mabetsea.
Nu yise besa soonamme oo nesookwaga'ena ka Te Naa mee oo netammana, nu oo sopedakwatoo e ya'ekwuna e namayodakwuna e nummekwunasoo.
U, Ne Naa gi e ya'ena petzape. U gi suda e tookoo manena soopetzape.
Nu ka umetuna. U e magwetzoikwusesoo. Nu yise u-baa'yoona tubetse besa soonammekwu,’

content: mee soo David tubo.

E nanumu, ka David-witu nu mu tuukwekwu. Tamme oo sopedakwatoo ka o'nosoo ka David tamme mooe tuukwe'e. Oosoo puu ka ya'ese, natuguse, tamme oo sopedakwatoo ka pukwi oo nakoopu. Oosoo gi nakwitusoo waha. Oosoo Te Pabe'e-witu te tuukwe.
Soo David oo sopedakwatoo ka Te Pabe'e saa'a nuugwekwuna. Soo Te Naasoo meeoo ka David tuukwe'e, ‘Sumu'yoo mu-nagatu Te Pabe'e manedooa. Oosoo mu nanumu moohedooa u-kwa'nesoo.’
Soo David ooka te tuukwe soo Te Pabe'e gi tubetse ya'e oo tookoo gi pehekwu. Oosoo tu ya'e-kwi'yoona namayodakwu.
Te Naasoo tuwow nakumma-baatoo oo ba'e, ka Te Pabe'e pooha-maka. Meno'o yise soo Te Pabe'e tu Besa Pooha-matu-ma ne sootuhi. Tamme oo nakana oo poonne. Soo Te Pabe'e toogoopatoo meapu.
Soo David gi oo manakwe. Soo David ookahoo waha Te Pabe'e-witu meeoo unakwe,

content.text: ‘Soo Te Naa ka Te Pabe'e nabaa katu tuungu.
Oosoo yise ka umu oo wokwohomu matzooekukwu.’

content: Ka Te Pabe'e-witu sakwa tamme Jew numu unusoo sopedakwatoo. Mu oo batsapu pana yise soo Te Naa ka Te Pabe'e oo mayugwese yise saa'a soo Te Pabe'e numu nemadunagakwu.”
Umu numu ka Peter nakase, unu suda oo sokwamakuna ka tu manena yise meeoo oo netamma oo poena'ewabe-nokosoo, “Ha'oo sakwa numme manese kaaheno oo mayugwe?”

Soo Peter mu nekwegease meeoo, “Mu sakwa ka suda mu manena ma'wu, baa-wi namatzakase mu numu ka Te Pabe'e naka'oedyuku. O'nosoo Te Naa no'oko mu sootuhise te ma'emukwana soomu'wakwunise ka Tu Besa Pooha-matu-ma mu sootuhi.
Oosoo Te Naa unnegeapu mee, ‘Mu nanumu, mu dooamu, yise no'oko numu mana kwinga'a-kwitu no'yoona e tunetutzeana, umu e dooamu manekwu,’ mee unnena.”
Soo Peter ewasoo meeoo mu numu tuukweyakwe, yise meeoo mu netamma, “Mu numu ewa suda manakwe yow meno'o. Soo Te Naa gi mu sootuhikwu, gi umu-wa'ne manepana, o'no saa'a mu namagwetzoikwu.”

Ewa'yoo (3,000) numu ka Peter naka'oedyuku ka o'no tabeno, umu baa-wi namatzaka. Umu nanesootuhiyakwe ka Te Naa tuukwewabe tu nakana pumme tunedyooe. Ka Te Pabe'e nabatsase oo soomayuna nanano tukana no'oko hemma nanatummatzina.
Mu nanana Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe Te Naa besa pooha-toohakwi ewow numu mabesakuyakwe, nanasookwugi tumada'e.
Mu Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukudu no'oko ka hemma nanatummatza'e.
Mu numu ewow hee-ga'yoo oo-ma tumuna, yise mu gi hee-gakoo tummatza'e.
Nonotza tabeno ka pabow nanesootuhi nobe-kwitoo meayakwe. Nanano tukayina tu pupua'amu nobe-kwi'yoona tooe ka besa nanano sokwamana,
ka Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhidyina. No'yoona mu numu nesookwuga'e ka mu besow umu tunaka'oedyukudu nono'otsa tabeba-wi nana'ewasoo maneno'o ka Te Naa numu magwetzoa'e ka nanano mu nanesootuha'e.

footnotes.text: -11 Nanakumma'akoosoo teepu-koobatu kemmana numme. Taba tsebooenakwana: Parthia, Media, Elam, Mesopotamia. Yise kwenahanakwana: Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia, Phrygia, Pamphylia, yise yaatu, yise taba meanakwana: Egypt, Arabia, Libya, menakwana Cyrene mee naneadu, yise taba egeanakwana: Rome, Crete. Susumudu tamme-matu tubetse Jew numu. Susumudu tamme-matu wakwawa'a pana Jew numu manena mayoho ka nanesootuhina.
